injuries.detail: Leonard (knee) has progressed in his strength and conditioning program but will miss at least one more week, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Zulfi Sheikh of Sportsnet.ca reports.
McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
